level_critical: This looks like a scam. Do not respond, pay, click links or share any details.
level_high: This content shows several signs of a likely scam. Do not send money or share details.
level_low: No strong scam signals were found, but stay alert.
level_medium: This content shows some warning signs. Verify before you act.
og_dot_chakshu: Report suspected fraud calls, SMS and WhatsApp messages on Chakshu, in the Department of Telecommunications' Sanchar Saathi portal.
og_i4c_digital_arrest: There is no such thing as a "digital arrest". Police, CBI, customs or courts never question people or demand money over video calls. Report such calls to 1930.
og_npci_pin: You never need to enter your UPI PIN or scan a QR code to receive money. A PIN is only for sending money.
og_rbi_buds: Collecting deposits from the public with promised returns, without regulatory approval, is banned under the Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act, 2019. Check and report such schemes on RBI's Sachet portal.
og_rbi_forex: Forex trading is allowed only through RBI-authorised persons and on authorised platforms or recognised exchanges. RBI publishes an Alert List of unauthorised forex trading platforms and apps.
og_rbi_liability: If money leaves your account without your consent, tell your bank at once. Under RBI's customer-protection rules, reporting quickly (within three working days) can limit your liability, in some cases to zero.
og_rbi_never_asks: RBI and banks never ask for your OTP, PIN, CVV or password by call, SMS, email or link. Never share them with anyone.
og_sebi_impersonation: Fraudsters misuse the names of SEBI and registered brokers. SEBI does not collect money from investors or ask for OTPs; verify any such message on sebi.gov.in.
og_sebi_no_guarantee: Investments in the securities market carry risk. No SEBI-registered entity is allowed to promise guaranteed or fixed returns.
og_sebi_registered: Only SEBI-registered Investment Advisers and Research Analysts may give paid advice or stock recommendations. Check the registration number on SEBI's list of recognised intermediaries.
og_sebi_valid_upi: SEBI-registered brokers and advisers collect money only through validated UPI IDs containing "@valid". Check a UPI ID with SEBI Check before paying.
otp: {code} is your Suraksha AI code. Valid for {minutes} min. Never share it - Suraksha AI will never call to ask for it.
privacy_collect: We store only what the app needs: your name, phone or email, language, and the results of the checks you run.
privacy_family: Your trusted contacts get an SMS only when you press Get Help or turn on automatic alerts.
privacy_local_ai: All AI runs on our own server. Your messages are not sent to any outside AI company.
privacy_never: We never ask for your OTP, PIN or passwords, never read your SMS or contacts, and never sell or share your data for advertising.
privacy_no_advice: Suraksha AI is for scam awareness and learning only. It never gives investment advice or recommends any product.
privacy_redact: OTPs, PINs, CVVs, card, Aadhaar, PAN and account numbers are hidden before any check and are never stored.
privacy_retention: Check results are deleted automatically after {days} days, or after 24 hours if you choose.
privacy_rights: You can download all your data or delete your account at any time in Settings.
privacy_uploads: Screenshots and PDFs are deleted as soon as their text is read.
rd_bank_account_tip: Add or update a nominee at your branch or in net banking, and tell a family member where the passbook is kept.
rd_demat_tip: Demat and trading accounts need a nominee or a formal opt-out. You can usually update it online with your broker or depository participant.
rd_epf_tip: Add EPF nominees on the EPFO member portal (e-nomination) and PPF nominees at your bank or post office.
rd_fixed_deposit_tip: Every FD can have a nominee. Check the FD receipt or ask the bank to confirm it is recorded.
rd_insurance_tip: Make sure every policy names a nominee and your family knows the insurer and where the policy papers are.
rd_locker_tip: Lockers can have nominees. Tell a trusted family member which branch holds the locker.
rd_mutual_fund_tip: Each mutual fund folio needs a nominee or an opt-out. You can update it on the fund house or registrar (RTA) website.
rd_nps_tip: Record nominees for your NPS account on the CRA portal or through your bank.
rd_post_office_tip: Post office savings schemes allow nominees. Update them at your post office.
rd_property_tip: Keep property papers in one safe place and tell your family where. A will helps avoid disputes.
rd_will_tip: A written will, kept safely and known to your family, avoids confusion. A nominee may only hold assets for the legal heirs, so a will matters too.
readiness_disclaimer: This checklist is for awareness and record-keeping only. It is not legal or financial advice. Never write account numbers, amounts or passwords here.
readiness_intro: If something happens to you, will your family be able to find and claim what you have saved? Tick each item once it is in order.
readiness_udgam: Money in old, forgotten bank accounts can be searched on RBI's UDGAM portal (udgam.rbi.org.in).
redacted_note: To protect you, we hid {items} before checking. They are never stored.
refusal: I can't give investment advice - I don't recommend stocks, funds or brokers, and I don't predict prices. What I can do is help you spot scams, understand manipulation tactics and build safe money habits. For personal investment advice, consult only a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser (RIA), whose registration you can verify on sebi.gov.in.
report_intro: Reporting helps stop the scammer and may help you recover money. Your complaint summary is ready below, with sensitive numbers already hidden.
report_step_1930: Lost money? Call 1930 right away. Reporting within the first few hours gives the best chance of freezing the money.
report_step_bank: If you shared any details, call your bank's official number to block your card or UPI.
report_step_chakshu: Report the scam call, SMS or WhatsApp number on Sanchar Saathi (Chakshu).
report_step_portal: File a complaint at cybercrime.gov.in (Report Cyber Crime → financial fraud) and paste the summary.
report_step_sebi: Fake investment adviser or stock-tip scam? Also complain on SEBI SCORES.
uncertainty_note: This is an automated estimate and it can be wrong. Before you pay or share anything, check with your bank's official number or call 1930.
weekly_report: Suraksha AI weekly report for {name}: safety score {score}/100, {scans} message(s) checked, {threats} threat(s) caught, learning streak {streak} day(s). {nudge}
